core_struggle: A woman working -hour night shifts and sending money home feels she is failing a test she never agreed to take, because every call ends with when are you getting married.
mirror: You send them half your salary, and every call ends with the same question you never asked.

queries.hook: The pride in their voice and the question at the end of every call, and the restless mind that cannot settle between the two. My parents' expectations weigh on me.
queries.diagnose: When your worth depends on their approval, every word of blame or pressure shakes you; craving approval keeps the mind unsteady.
queries.steady: Praise and blame come and go like the wind; what is yours to do is yours to do, and no one else can take that from you.
queries.act: Practise being on your own side; let their praise and their questions come and go without letting either decide your worth today.
queries.story: A woman who built something for her family with her own hands, faced the same question again and again, and found a way to stand in her own worth.

weeks: The test you never agreed to
No one else can take what is yours
bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call needing their approval, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: By the end of the week the test you feel you are failing is named, and the part of you that can stand in its own worth has the floor.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the pride and the question, and the restless mind between them, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the restless mind comes from needing their approval to settle a clock that is not yours.
week_beats.steady: You hold that praise and blame come and go, and what is yours to do is yours to do.
week_beats.act: You try being on your own side for one evening, letting their praise and their questions come and go without deciding your worth.

insight: You are building something for them with your work, and the test you feel you are failing is the one they keep asking about.
details: parents are proud but end every call with marriage
